request.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Recolour only the crystals and change nothing else: every pink crystal of the head and shoulders becomes rock candy of glossy mint green, colour #7fe0b0, with lighter #c8f5df facets and white highlights, shaded deeper green #3fa878. No pink is left. Keep the caramel brown face and bands, the eyes, the mint trim, the tiny sprinkles, every shape, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
